triage.summary: Olivia Brown from Brown Bakery asks whether Alex can automate their cake order form to send orders to a Google Sheet and what it would cost.

task.title: Assess the cake order automation and provide a quote
task.description: Olivia Brown (olivia@brownbakery.com) wants cake order form submissions sent automatically to a Google Sheet. Ask for the form link or platform, assess the integration, and provide pricing.

reply.body:
Hi Olivia,

Could you send me a link to your cake order form or let me know which platform it uses? That will help me assess how to connect it to Google Sheets and give you a quote.

Thanks,
Alex
